historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds per-array link/count reconciliation and empty-slot policy but lowers capability for pending inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify that Number of Memory Devices in each Type 16 array equals the approved number of physical memory-device sockets represented by linked Type 17 records, including applicable unpopulated sockets, and remains consistent after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 16/17 data, identify every array handle, count all Type 17 records whose Physical Memory Array Handle references it under the approved empty/disabled-slot policy, reconcile declared and observed counts, and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the board socket topology/count policy and reboot plan. No DIMM insertion or removal is needed.
required_inputs: Expected memory-device socket count for each Type 16 array
Treatment of unpopulated, disabled, soldered and logical-device records
Rules for orphaned, duplicate or vendor-specific Type 17 records
Validated dmidecode/parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS inventory; do not insert, remove or reseat DIMMs.
Count Type 17 records by exact Physical Memory Array Handle, not by global record count or populated Size alone.
Keep total socket records, populated devices and OS-visible memory as separate metrics.
Report orphaned/duplicate handles and omitted empty sockets; do not normalize them away.
Stop on topology ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Map all Type 17 records to Type 16 arrays, compute declared-versus-linked socket counts and population subsets, then compare pre/post reboot evidence.
Do not change slot state, infer undocumented topology or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-array physical socket counts and inclusion/exclusion rules.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The declared number is relevant, but grep -A1 loses array handle and cannot prove the linked Type 17 count or whether empty slots are represented.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 16/17 raw and decoded output; report per array the declared device count, linked Type 17 handles/locators, total linked records, populated count and any orphan/duplicate.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Number of Memory Devices scope, Type 16 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing and physical memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build the Type 16-to-Type 17 reference graph, count all linked device/socket records under the approved topology policy, separately summarize population, and compare declared counts before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 16 arrays with Type 17 device/socket records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and dmidecode/parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 16 Number of Memory Devices and Type 17 Physical Memory Array Handle semantics, plus board slot topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds per-array referential counting and separates socket capacity from populated devices.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing empty-slot records, wrong-array links, duplicates/orphans and accidental comparison with installed DIMM count.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board socket counts and record-inclusion policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS memory inventory generally exposes populated resources only and cannot prove the number of physical sockets.

project_override_considerations: A project may document disabled or non-fielded sockets, but must state whether firmware should still expose their Type 17 records and adjust the expected per-array count explicitly; current population is not a valid silent override.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, per-array socket counts and empty/disabled/soldered-slot policy
Per-array declared count, full linked record list, populated subset and orphan/duplicate analysis
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot count/reference diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The count has clear per-array record semantics; the platform topology and empty-slot policy are normal inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Reference mapping and count reconciliation are fully automatable after inputs and require no physical operation.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds per-array handles, Type 17 reconciliation and separation of socket versus populated counts.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates project count policy and engineer verdict from automated graph/count validation.

review_improvement: Prevents a declared number from passing when Type 17 coverage is incomplete or when a populated-DIMM count is incorrectly substituted for physical device slots.
independent_technical_reasoning: The declared count and all Type 17 references are enumerable structured data; once topology rules are supplied, equality and anomaly checks are deterministic.
